subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Should automatic daily and idle rollovers extend the existing reset hooks with a typed automatic reason, or receive a distinct typed session lifecycle event for workspace hooks and plugins?
rationale: The missing behavior is a core extension contract rather than a contained bug: the choice determines the public meaning, timing, and compatibility of existing internal and plugin hook APIs.

options.title: Add a typed automatic-reset lifecycle event
options.body: Introduce a distinct, documented event carrying `daily` or `idle` reason and previous-session context, then make `session-memory` subscribe to it.

options.title: Extend existing reset hooks
options.body: Preserve the existing hook names but add an explicit automatic reason/context so listeners can distinguish command and rollover resets.

options.title: Keep persistence owner-specific
options.body: Limit the change to bundled session-memory and defer a general workspace-hook API until a wider lifecycle design is approved.

recommendation.title: Add a typed automatic-reset lifecycle event
recommendation.body: Introduce a distinct, documented event carrying `daily` or `idle` reason and previous-session context, then make `session-memory` subscribe to it.

likelyOwner.reason: The overlapping implementation and the current hook/plugin ownership trail both converge on this area.
